The declared command passed through Git Bash on Node v26.7.0 (269 tests, lint, coverage), and the CI-equivalent Node v24.19.0 coverage command passed with 269 tests and 88.78/83.64/94.64 percent line/branch/function coverage. Real stdio MCP/local HTTP stub tests verify bounded TIMEOUT, cancellation-driven socket closure, one provider request, and secret-free tool/stderr output.
